Vision Government Solutions

|

SOUTHBRIDGE,MA

|

Welcome

Welcome to the Southbridge MA Online Assessment Database.

The Town of Southbridge has completed its revaluation program
for assessments for all classes of property. We have received approval from the
Massachusetts Department of Revenue (DOR) that our property values are at “Full
and Fair Cash Value”.

The Fiscal Year 2026 Tax Rate is $14.89 per thousand dollars
valuation.

If you have any questions or concerns regarding your assessed
value or the data on your property, please contact the Assessor’s Office at
508-764-5404. Office hours are Monday – Wednesday 8:00 a.m. – 4:00 p.m., Thursday
8:00 a.m. – 8:00 p.m., and Friday 8:00 a.m. – 12:00 p.m.

The Southbridge Board of Assessors hopes that you find this
information helpful and convenient.

(c) 2026 Vision Government Solutions, Inc. All rights reserved.
